Lab Notes — Project ANIMA
Dr. E. Hale

Day 14. The resonance from the dig site artifact is not decay. It responds. We mapped the frequency and got a structured reply.

Something on the other side is answering on purpose.

Day 19. Dr. Voss says stop the experiment. I say we are close. The signal now names us.

Day 23. We opened a window, not a door. A small one. It should have been enough.

It was not a window. It was a seam.

If anyone reads this: we did not open the world. We only proved it was already open.

The readings continue on three bands. Three. Remember the number three.
